data: Is the line represented by the dotted pink markers consistently above the line represented by the solid orange markers in the left graph?

The question asks whether the line represented by the dotted pink markers is consistently above the line represented by the solid orange markers in the left graph. 

From the caption, we know that the left graph shows the alignment of a partially trained EN vector space to a fully trained vector space. The lines represent RSIM scores, mapping performance (i.e., monolingual “BLI”), and monolingual word similarity scores on SimVerb-3500. The dotted pink markers correspond to the "SimVerb" line, and the solid orange markers correspond to the "RSIM: LFREQ" line.

By analyzing the left graph, we can see that the dotted pink markers (SimVerb) are consistently above the solid orange markers (RSIM: LFREQ) throughout the entire range of the x-axis. This indicates that the line represented by the dotted pink markers is indeed consistently above the line represented by the solid orange markers.
